name: @avant-garde/skill-offers
description: Offer Agent skill pack (spec 32): canonical manifest compilation, dark-pattern gating, and experiment decision logic for storefront offers. Vendored into the console template and the pooled runtime (spec 32 D6/OQ4) rather than depended on directly, mirroring email-campaign/social-media. The pack never touches a platform credential — OfferPlatformClient and OfferAttributionClient are seams each binding supplies.
